purpose:
Accepts one 2S battery source, blocks reverse connection, shuts down a faulty input and retries,
and holds the battery enable on through a flight-computer reset aloft (FC_POWER_HOLD).
connects_to:
Standalone battery or Foinse mate -> battery monitor shunt -> logic and output branches. The external switch is on 44-master-enable.
ENERGY_TAP (Q101 drain, ahead of the eFuse) -> output arm feeds on 06*, battery-monitor VBUS on 07a.

purpose: Chooses battery or USB to run the logic. Battery takes priority; this circuit does not charge it.
connects_to: Protected battery from 01-power and USB from 04c -> 01c preregulator. 01b decides which downstream circuits may start.

purpose: Lets the board start before firmware is running, then hands the appropriate power controls to the flight MCU.
connects_to: Battery/USB status -> comms power enable; 4V_PRE level -> core input enable. Feeds the held flight path, comms limiter and the inter-MCU status link.

purpose: Efficiently reduces the selected input to about 4 V before the quieter 3.3 V regulators.
connects_to: 01a source selector -> 01d held flight input, 01comms-limit and 01optional-limit. This is a shared supply, not redundant power.

purpose: Reserves local energy for the flight MCU during a brief input dip, and blocks that energy flowing back upstream.
connects_to: 01c 4 V supply, enabled by its own level (01b) -> 01flight-ldo. Hold-up time is not proved.

purpose: Limits current into the comms branch so a fault there is less able to collapse the shared supply.
connects_to: 01c 4 V supply and 01b comms permission -> 01comms-ldo. It latches off after a qualifying fault; restart behaviour needs testing.

purpose: Limits current into optional peripherals, which must not be required for flight to continue.
connects_to: 01c 4 V supply and SERVICE_POWER_EN from the flight MCU -> 01optional-ldo -> separately controlled peripheral circuits.

purpose: Makes the quiet 3.3 V supply for the flight-critical electronics.
connects_to: 01d held flight input -> FLIGHT_3V3. The 0-ohm link can disconnect this positive supply during bench diagnosis; ground stays connected.

purpose: Makes a separate quiet 3.3 V supply for the communications electronics.
connects_to: 01comms-limit -> COMMS_3V3 -> comms MCU and its controlled peripherals. This is a separate branch, not a second flight computer.

purpose: Makes the 3.3 V supply used by optional, separately switched peripherals.
connects_to: 01optional-limit -> 3V3_OPTIONAL -> peripheral power switches. Individual sheets show which loads may be turned off.

purpose: Runs flight sensing, estimation, mission decisions, recording, outputs and both vehicle CAN buses.
connects_to: Sensor/storage sheets 03*, outputs 06*, CAN 05, monitoring 07*/08, comms link 04b and the power hold on 01-power. Supplies/clocks/test pads: 02a. Reset/debug: 02flight-reset-debug.

purpose:
Gives the flight MCU stable local supplies, its two clock sources, the backup-domain feed,
the watchdog-reset memory, the timing strobe and the spare test pads.
connects_to: FLIGHT_3V3 -> U201 on 02-flight-mcu; FLIGHT_MR_N from the watchdog on 02flight-reset-debug. Main 16 MHz clock and 32.768 kHz RTC clock are separate; their startup margins need measurement.

purpose: Holds the flight MCU in reset when its supply is unsuitable, and gives us a dedicated programming/debug connection.
connects_to: Flight rail + external watchdog -> supervisor -> U201 reset. Tag-Connect goes to U201 SWD; reset also inhibits output authority.

purpose: Resets the comms MCU cleanly and provides its own programming/debug connection.
connects_to: COMMS_3V3 and flight reset request through 04b -> supervisor -> U401. The flight and comms reset wires are separate.

purpose: Stores the flight record locally so loss of radio does not lose the data.
connects_to: Flight MCU quad-SPI -> 256 MiB NOR. Its supply switch and signal switches let the flight MCU turn the memory off without powering it through data pins.

purpose: Measures low-g acceleration and rotation with the ST IMU.
connects_to: Flight MCU SPI/control/interrupt pins -> this sensor. Fed from FLIGHT_3V3 through R3101, a 47 ohm link: a shorted sensor draws <=71 mA (D-6.6, D-2Nov.3).

purpose: Measures low-g acceleration and rotation with a second IMU from TDK.
connects_to: Flight MCU SPI/control/interrupt pins -> this sensor. Fed from FLIGHT_3V3 through R3201, a 47 ohm link, like the ST IMU (D-6.6, D-2Nov.3).

purpose: Measures acceleration beyond the low-g IMUs' range, using the ADXL375.
connects_to: Flight MCU SPI and data-ready pins -> this high-g sensor. Fed from FLIGHT_3V3 through R3301, a 47 ohm link (D-6.6, D-2Nov.3).

purpose: Measures air pressure with the Bosch BMP390, one of the two dissimilar pressure sensors.
connects_to: Its own flight-MCU I2C bus, address 0x76, supplied through R3401, a 47 ohm link from FLIGHT_3V3 (D-6.6, D-2Nov.3). Pressure is not a valid height measurement across the whole space-shot profile.

purpose: Measures air pressure with the TE MS5607, independently of the Bosch sensor.
connects_to: Its own flight-MCU I2C bus, address 0x77, supplied through R3501, a 47 ohm link from FLIGHT_3V3 (D-6.6, D-2Nov.3). Both pressure readings go to the estimator; neither proves full-envelope height.

purpose:
Measures the magnetic field for heading and roll, read at 100 Hz and logged. Non-essential:
it never gates the watchdog or the estimator (D-2Nov.11).
connects_to: FLIGHT_3V3 through R3701 -> MAG_3V3; I2C3 (PA8 MAG_SCL, PC9 MAG_SDA) and MAG_INT (PE6) on 02-flight-mcu.

purpose: Handles radio, GNSS and USB service so those tasks cannot monopolise the flight MCU.
connects_to: UART link to flight: 04b. USB: 04c. GNSS: 04d. Radio: 04e/04f. Local supplies/clocks: 04a; reset/debug: 02comms-reset-debug.

purpose: Gives the comms MCU stable local supplies and its main clock.
connects_to: COMMS_3V3 -> U401 on 04-comms-gnss-radio. The 16 MHz crystal belongs only to this MCU; flight has its own clocks.

purpose: Passes messages and a few control/status signals between the processors without feeding power through an off MCU.
connects_to: U201 flight <-> U401 comms. Includes the flight-requested comms reset, battery-valid status and USB permission, not just UART data.

purpose: Lets a laptop power service logic and exchange data with the comms MCU.
connects_to: USB-C -> current-limited logic input on 01a, and protected USB data -> U401. USB does not charge batteries or power energetic outputs.

purpose: Gets satellite position and time from an antenna mounted outside the carbon airframe.
connects_to: Passive antenna/SMA -> MAX-M10S -> comms UART, pulse-per-second and reset. Power needs both battery-valid and the comms request. No antenna bias or ANT_CHECK.

purpose: Switches radio power and disconnects its signal pins when that power is off.
connects_to: COMMS_3V3 and comms control -> Wio module on 04f. Battery-valid is also required; USB-only service cannot turn the radio on.

purpose: Sends telemetry over the sub-GHz radio link.
connects_to: Comms SPI/status signals through 04e -> Wio-LR2021 -> vertical SMA/external antenna. Flight does not wait for radio to succeed.

purpose:
Connects the flight MCU to the propulsion controller (bus 1, FDCAN1, J501) and to the active board
(bus 2, FDCAN2, J502), each over its own wired CAN pair.
connects_to:
Flight CAN pins -> switched transceivers -> Harwin Gecko-SL H / L / reference. Each link is two nodes at
500 kbit/s; neither connector supplies power. Both transceivers share CAN_3V3 (PB1) and standby (PE10).

purpose: Holds the staging channel inhibited after any flight reset or power-up, until the flight MCU clocks the latch with staging disarmed (D-7.2).
connects_to: FLIGHT_NRST, PD15 request and STAGE_ARM_INVALID (06a) -> STAGE_ELIGIBLE to 06pyro3; STAGE_INHIBIT_LATCHED -> PE14. This logic does not replace a physical energy disconnect.

purpose: Feeds each pyro group from ENERGY_TAP through its own fuse and external arm switch, and senses the armed voltage.
connects_to: ENERGY_TAP (01-power) -> F6101 / F6102 -> J6101 / J6102 -> RECOVERY_ARMED_VBAT (06pyro1, 06pyro2) and STAGING_ARMED_VBAT (06pyro3); arm sense -> PE13 / PE15.

purpose: Shows the two switched sides for recovery channel 1: PE7 drives the high side, PA9 the low side.
connects_to: RECOVERY_ARMED_VBAT (06a) and the flight MCU -> J6601 load pair on 06b; current report -> 06c. Energy link remains DNP: do not connect an initiator.

purpose: Shows the two switched sides for recovery channel 2: PE9 drives the high side, PC8 the low side.
connects_to: RECOVERY_ARMED_VBAT (06a) and the flight MCU -> J6601 load pair on 06b; current report -> 06c. Energy link remains DNP: do not connect an initiator.

purpose: Shows the two switched sides for the staging channel: PE12 through the latch AND gate drives the high side, PD14 the low side.
connects_to: STAGING_ARMED_VBAT (06a), STAGE_ELIGIBLE (06-outputs) and the flight MCU -> J6601 load pair on 06b; current report -> 06c. Energy link remains DNP: do not connect an initiator.

purpose: Defines the physical connector contacts for three energetic loads.
connects_to: Three channel sheets -> J6601. Both wires of each energetic load return here; LOW is a switched return, not ground.

purpose: Reduces and filters each channel's current-report signal before the flight MCU measures it.
connects_to: Three high-side switches -> resistor/filter networks -> flight ADC. The separate continuity inputs only have default pulls here; their test circuit is on 06e/06f.

purpose: Shows the proposed low-current check for whether each external load is connected.
connects_to: External load pairs -> test/return resistors -> divider on 06f -> flight ADC. Test and return resistors are 3.9k, safe for an igniter with a no-fire current of 25 mA or more.

purpose: Finishes the continuity voltage dividers and disconnects them from an unpowered flight ADC.
connects_to: Return measurements on 06e -> analog switches -> flight ADC, with default pulls on 06c. No continuity result is a physical disarm proof.

purpose: Supplies limited 3.3 V power and a controlled monitoring bus to Foinse and the local current monitor.
connects_to: Optional rail + flight I2C -> Samtec mate and INA228 on 07a. Foinse source protection starts independently of this auxiliary supply.

purpose: Measures bulk battery current and input voltage, including when Croi runs without Foinse.
connects_to: 01-power eFuse -> 5 mOhm shunt -> downstream loads. INA228 reports over the controlled I2C bus on 07. USB-only current does not pass through this shunt.

purpose: Lets the flight MCU read battery, flight-supply and recovery-arm voltages.
connects_to: Three rails -> resistor dividers -> power-off signal switches -> flight ADC. Voltage readings are useful evidence, not permission to fire or proof of isolation.

purpose: Shows basic power/readiness status and provides audible bench/startup feedback without a display.
connects_to: Flight PD7 -> complementary red/green LEDs; comms and hardware power have separate LEDs. Flight PD6 -> passive piezo. Green means checks passed, not armed.

purpose: Lets an external maintained switch turn Croi's battery path on and off, without carrying load current through the switch.
connects_to: J103 pin 1 is a limited 3 V bias; pin 2 returns to the eFuse SHDN input on 01-power. Open/unplugged means electronic OFF, not physical disconnection.
